**Wayne Arthur Scott Jr.** was a Hot Wheels designer who worked for Mattel from 1997 to 2009. He was mainly a graphic designer, with his name appearing on numerous castings as a sponsor decal; in addition to graphics, Scott also designed castings but not in large volumes. Prior to his stint at Mattel, Scott did graphics for Revell's NASCAR model kits. He passed away on 26 March 2017, aged 45; a cause of death was not announced.
